column12: Under the published monthly-streaming tariff, KRW 912.45 is the mechanical 10.5% gross-sales benchmark for Melon's regular streaming-club price. This is not a full tariff upper bound because the subscriber or usage floor could bind above this level.
This benchmark applies only to the gross-sales branch of the public tariff and should not be read as a complete incidence estimate for download-inclusive or hybrid plan economics.
Lossless or premium features do not change the coding rule here: the row is a mechanical gross-sales-branch benchmark rather than a point estimate of realized royalty incidence.
This row is retained as a lower-priced domestic benchmark under the same gross-sales branch logic, not as proof that mobile-only plans escape or alter the published royalty-base rule.

Even if the entire gross-sales-branch benchmark were passed through to consumers without overshifting, the same-country YouTube full-bundle subsidy relative to Premium Lite plus Melon regular would still exceed it by KRW 1377.55.
